info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Continuity Planning API
info.description: The Business Continuity Planning API provides essential functionality for organizations to assess and manage their business direction during unforeseen disruptions. It allows users to retrieve critical information regarding continuity strategies and recovery objectives tailored for specific business units or departments. Typical consumers of this API include business analysts, operational managers, and disaster recovery teams who need to inform decision-making processes and ensure organizational resilience. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their preparedness and response capabilities in the face of unexpected challenges.

get.description: Fetch the specified continuity planning resource identified by RES-100045. This endpoint provides detailed information necessary for understanding the continuity planning framework established for the given business direction.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve operations related to continuity planning under business direction. It requires specific parameters defined in the schema to ensure correct data retrieval.

GetBusinessDirectionContinuityPlanningRe.description: A request body string that represents the payload for the GET operation related to business direction and continuity planning.

GetBusinessDirectionContinuityPlanningRe.title: Continuity Planning Response

initiativeId.description: The unique identifier for the planning initiative.

sponsorId.description: The unique identifier for the sponsor of the initiative.

planningHorizon.description: The timeframe within which the planning is expected to take place.

targetDate.description: The target date for the completion of the initiative.

status.description: The current status of the initiative.

recordStatus.description: The status indicating the record's current state (e.g., Active, Inactive).

version.description: The version number of the initiative.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of when the initiative was last updated.

GetBusinessDirectionContinuityPlanningRe.description: This schema represents the response structure for the operations continuity planning API.

ResponseMetadata.title: Response Metadata

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the API response.

correlationId.description: The identifier used to correlate requests and responses across the system.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp at which the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region in which the response was processed.

ResponseMetadata.description: This schema represents the metadata associated with the API response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that was called. This allows tracking and monitoring of usage patterns and performance metrics specific to the endpoint.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application where the request was processed. This header helps identify which application handled the request in a multi-application environment.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication using a Bearer token in the HTTP Authorization header. The token should be a valid JSON Web Token (JWT).
